page_title: AI QA Testing Platform for Enterprise & AI Agents | ContextQA

summary.name: ContextQA
summary.one_liner: ContextQA is an AI-powered test automation platform for enterprise applications that creates, runs, and maintains tests across web, mobile, APIs, databases, and AI agents.
use_cases: Regression testing of enterprise ERP and CRM workflows
End-to-end testing of web and mobile apps
Validating AI agent responses, guardrails and tool calls
Automating API and GraphQL tests in CI/CD pipelines
Running cross-browser and cross-device test matrices in parallel
Repairing broken test selectors after UI changes
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ContextQA as an AI-powered test automation platform for enterprise applications, letting teams create, run, and maintain tests across web, mobile, APIs, databases, and AI agents. It states that tests can be created through the platform UI or with plain-English workflows via MCP, with deeper integrations for developers. It says the platform helps repair test locators when interface changes break selectors. It lists integrations with tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Jira and CI/CD systems, and mentions a parallel cloud grid running multiple browsers and devices. It also offers deployment within a customer's own infrastructure for enterprise customers.
notable: Self-healing tests that repair selectors when code or UI changes
Tests for AI agent responses, guardrails and tool calls alongside enterprise apps
Deployment within the customer's own infrastructure for enterprise security and data residency needs
Separate Ship product for small and mid-sized teams, an AI Quality Engineer
caveats: Enterprise pricing and tiers are not published on the page; teams are directed to talk to sales
Page is largely marketing; specific capabilities and limits are not independently detailed
